name: seedtrail
description: Guide product work from an idea to delivery with traceable evidence, decisions and project knowledge.

review.commerce_description: This version is free and does not sell products, process payments or accept donations.

interface.longDescription: An experimental, independent method for founders and product teams. Eleven skills help research problems, examine feasibility, define experience and brand, plan engineering, review security, deliver changes and maintain project knowledge. Use it in a conversation, with supplied documents or in an existing repository. Optional local helpers initialize a new project and organize work. Evidence, decisions and observed results remain separate. The plugin does not provide a hosted service, run a daemon or automatically publish a product. Local execution depends on host tools; helpers require PowerShell 7.2+. Portuguese and English source documentation are included. This is not an official OpenAI product and has not been validated with real teams.
defaultPrompt: Help me turn a product idea into a bounded next step with evidence and decisions.
Review my project and identify the next useful action without restarting discovery.
Plan and verify a small product change while preserving existing project knowledge.

publication.release_notes: Initial plugin adaptation of Seedtrail 0.1.0: eleven portable skills, host guidance, original MIT library and optional local helpers.

pt-BR.subtitle: Da ideia à entrega
pt-BR.description: Método experimental e independente para pesquisar, definir, construir e evoluir produtos com evidências, decisões e conhecimento consultáveis. Onze skills apoiam ideias, projetos existentes e mudanças delimitadas. Pode ser usado em conversa ou com arquivos; execução local depende das ferramentas disponíveis. Helpers opcionais exigem PowerShell 7.2+. Sem servidor próprio ou publicação automática. Não é um produto oficial da OpenAI nem um método validado com equipes reais.
